title: Price Alerts
subtitle: Send Feishu card notifications when a symbol's price crosses a threshold for a sustained period
instruction1: Configure symbol, direction (above/below), trigger price, duration seconds, and max notifications.
instruction2: Price is evaluated on current bid; duration counts strictly consecutive satisfaction.
instruction3: A rule auto-deactivates once it reaches the send limit — you can re-enable it manually.
instruction4: On first use, click “Test Send” to verify the Feishu webhook; if it reports not configured, set the FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable on the server.
statusBanner.disabled: ⚠️ Feishu not configured: rules are saved, but no message will be sent
statusBanner.disabledDetail: The server is missing the FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable, so the alert engine has stopped sending. Set it and restart the service, then use “Test Send” below to verify.
emptyDescription: Click “Add Alert” to create your first price threshold alert.
testSent: Test card sent, check the Feishu group
testFailed: Test send failed, check Feishu webhook config
